description: The City Auditor's audit of non-competitive City contracts, its 13 recommendations, City management's responses, and the Council's direction that the City Manager report back on them.

qualifications.quote: We have not yet confirmed to what extent any recommendations may have been implemented prior to the audit release date.

title: City Contracts audit (City Auditor, February 2026)

description: City Council, 2024-01-16, Item 28: Consideration of Options for Berkeley High School Staff Parking. Moved to the Consent Calendar and adopted as amended to apply only to RPP Area C. The same action referred options to increase walking, biking, carpooling and transit use by Berkeley High employees and students to the 2x2 Committee and the City Manager, and asked BUSD to consider formally withdrawing from planning a garage on its Milvia Street property. On 2024-06-04 the Council re-approved the findings and set how the number of permits is calculated (Resolution No. 71,358-N.S.).
title: Berkeley High School staff parking permits
